content:
“Squad! Move out! Go go go!”

**Squad Maneuvers** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased running speed when part of a team.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Run 20% faster when part of a team. | 0038AB95 | 
| ★ | 1 | Run 10% faster when part of a team. | 0038AB94 | 

- This perk does not make a player's sprint faster (the use of Action Points to run faster), and only affects running and walking speeds.
- Squad Maneuvers affects the speed of sneaking as well.
- Maximum possible speed bonus can be achieved by Speed Demon alone, so using Squad Maneuvers in addition to the mutation will not provide any additional bonus.
- The perk checks if a player is on a team, not if the number of teammates is greater than zero, meaning it will work if the player is on a team by themselves.
